# Photo Fixion

> Photo Fixion is a professional photo editing and image retouching service for e-commerce businesses, photographers, studios and agencies. A team of 50+ Photoshop editors delivers hand-edited images in 24 hours, with 12-hour and 6-hour express options.

Key facts:
- Tagline: A Home of Speed, Skill & Savings
- Experience: 10 years; team of 50+ editors working around the clock
- Turnaround: 24 hours standard, 12 hours express, 6 hours rush
- Free trial, revisions and bulk discounts are available
- Pricing is quoted per order based on service, complexity and volume
- Contact: photofixionbd@gmail.com, phone and WhatsApp +880 1718-895943, open 24 hours

## Services
- [Clipping Path](https://photofixion.com/services/clipping-path): Hand-drawn paths that cut products cleanly from any background.
- [Background Removal](https://photofixion.com/services/background-removal): Clean white, transparent or custom backgrounds for product photos.
- [Image Masking](https://photofixion.com/services/image-masking): Precise masks for hair, fur, fabric and semi-transparent objects.
- [Ghost Mannequin](https://photofixion.com/services/ghost-mannequin): The invisible mannequin effect that shows the fit of apparel.
- [Photo Retouching](https://photofixion.com/services/photo-retouching): Natural clean-up for products, portraits and high-end campaigns.
- [Color Correction](https://photofixion.com/services/color-correction): Accurate, consistent colour and fast colour variants.
- [Shadow Creation](https://photofixion.com/services/shadow-creation): Drop, natural, cast and reflection shadows that add depth.
- [Product Photo Editing](https://photofixion.com/services/product-photo-editing): Complete, store-ready editing for whole product catalogues.
